thread:
elaine.m: Hey team — Citrine Health case study update. Need to lock interview times, final quote copy, and confirm legal signoff window. Planning to publish alongside the benchmark post and a short webinar.

sam.k: I can run the interview. Available Tue/Wed next week 10–12 PT. Prefer to get a short video clip plus 2 written soundbites.

devon.r: Sales wants the customer quote to mention throughput gains and cost per inference reductions. Can we get numbers in this format: "XX% latency reduction / $YY per 1k tokens saved"?

maya.l: @elaine.m pls confirm Citrine signed the standard quote release. I have a redline on paragraph 3 around customer-identifiable metrics — they asked to anonymize patient counts.

elaine.m: They sent a draft release earlier today (attached). @maya.l can you share high-level redlines by EOD? We want to ship the blog + benchmark on Thursday and host the webinar the following Tuesday.

maya.l: Will review. Quick Q: does the benchmark include raw latency charts with request-level traces? If so, we need to ensure no PHI in traces.

sam.k: Bench is aggregated p50/p95/p99 only, no raw traces in public assets. We do have a short appendix with test harness details.

devon.r: For the webinar, can we have a 15–20m slot where Citrine co-present? They'll do a 5–7 min customer story + 10 min Q&A. Need speaker names and bios by Friday.

elaine.m: Good. @devon.r can you confirm speaker list with Citrine? I'll draft the promo copy and ask design for a hero image.

ops-bot: Reminder: embargo date set to 2026-04-02 08:00 UTC. Assets pushed to /releases/citrine-2026/v1.1 (read-only).

maya.l: Redlines done — sent to Citrine legal. They approved the quote with one wording tweak: replace "patient cohort" with "user cohort". Also requested removal of exact patient volume.

sam.k: Updated draft includes the revised quote and a short breakout: "With Redwood, we halved inference latency and cut inference costs by 42% while maintaining model quality." Thoughts?

devon.r: That reads well. Can we add a single metric callout in the blog: "42% cost reduction (inference spend)" — approved by Citrine legal?

maya.l: Citrine approved the phrasing as long as we don't call out proprietary numbers. The percentage above is ok since they supplied it. I added the signed release to the drive.

elaine.m: Awesome. Next steps: - Sam to finalize interview script and record by Wed. - Devon to confirm webinar speakers + bios by Fri. - Maya to attach signed release and final redline notes. - Design to produce hero and social assets by Wed afternoon.

sam.k: I'll post the interview agenda here once done. Also requesting a 20-min dry run with Citrine and product on Monday.

devon.r: I'll loop in Citrine contacts this afternoon.

elaine.m: Thanks all — syncing in tomorrow 11am PT for a quick handoff. :thumbsup:
